tools.name: search_cases
tools.description: Search ProofStack's audited business-model case studies of small software products. Every case carries revenue and pricing claims linked to public sources with an evidence grade, plus an explicit list of what does NOT transfer to other builders.

tools.name: get_case
tools.description: Fetch one audited case by slug: pricing tiers as published, the paid trigger, what to copy, what NOT to copy, and every evidence source with its URL and grade.

tools.name: pricing_benchmarks
tools.description: Pricing statistics counted from the published pricing pages of audited cases: median first paid tier, free-tier prevalence, and which capabilities most often sit behind the paywall.
